notes:
Summary: AxonFlow is a contact-center SaaS (cloud + on-prem options) building real-time agent assist as a core differentiator. Looking for a partner to run streaming suggestions (token-by-token), synchronous tool-calls to backend ticketing CRM, and robust fallback policies during spikes. 

What they told us / quote: "We need suggestions in under ~300ms so agents don't pause — 95th <250ms ideal for top-tier flows. If latency climbs, fall back to safe canned replies and async summarization." 

Technical requirements / priorities (shorthand):
- Use-case: real-time suggestions + immediate tool-calls (update ticket, create follow-ups) + post-call ticket summarization
- Latency SLOs: end-to-end suggestion <300ms (median <120ms, 95th <250ms)
- Throughput: baseline ~3k rps, peak campaigns up to 15k rps for short windows (10-20m bursts)
- Models: want low-latency quantized 13B for live suggestions, fallback 3B for overload; open to Redwood-verified low-latency variants
- Guardrails: strict blacklist + phrase-level moderation, hallucination detection for tool-calls, prompting templates for function-calling
- Routing: region-aware routing (NA primary, failover to EU), policy-based fallback (latency-first during spikes), sticky sessions for agent context
- Caching/optimization: prefix/KV cache for recurring dialogs, session-level KV persisted to fast store, batching for backend summarization only
- Observability: token-level cost and latency, trace for each tool-call, per-route SLAs, alerting on quality regressions
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 2y, KMS integration for key control, must pass SOC2-like questionnaire; possible data residency EU for some customers

POC scope proposed: 4-week POC using Dedicated pool + optional on-prem proxy for ticket-tool-calls. Deliverables: latency report, failover behavior, guardrails test, cost per 1M tokens.

Concerns from their infra lead: appliance sizing for bursts, certificate/key management for on-prem proxy, and DB transaction idempotency when a tool-call is retried.

Notes from AE/SE: prioritize demo with streaming SDK + live tool-calling flow (create ticket from suggestion) and show automatic fallback to smaller model under load. Show Optimize suggestions for batching/caching that cut token spend ~20%.

- Legal: push DPA + KMS clause, target sign-off (by 2026-04-02)
- SE: run full-load sim with 15k rps bursts and collect 95th latency profile (by 2026-03-22)
